learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the sour and bitter chemicals in your home, how they neutralize each other, and how the universal pH scale measures their power!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Acids are sour, turn blue litmus red, and release H⁺ ions in water. Bases are bitter, feel soapy, turn red litmus blue, and release OH⁻ ions in water. Water-soluble bases are called Alkalis.
These are substances that change color or smell when put in an acid or a base. Examples: Litmus (natural), Phenolphthalein (synthetic), and Onion/Vanilla (olfactory indicators which change smell).
A scale from 0 to 14 measuring hydrogen ion concentration. pH < 7 is acidic, pH = 7 is neutral (pure water), and pH > 7 is basic. The lower the pH, the stronger the acid.
When an acid reacts with a metal, it releases Hydrogen gas (H₂). When an acid and a base mix, they cancel each other out to form Salt and Water (Neutralization: Acid + Base → Salt + Water).

Common salt (NaCl) is a raw material for many chemicals. Baking Soda makes cakes fluffy. Washing Soda removes permanent hardness of water. Plaster of Paris (PoP) is used by doctors to set fractured bones.

fun_activity.title: 🚥 The Turmeric Test
fun_activity.instructions: Take a white cloth and rub some turmeric (haldi) paste on it. Now, apply some soap solution (which is a base) on it. The yellow turmeric magically turns deep red! This shows turmeric is a natural indicator.

exam_tips: 📌 Know the Pop-sound test: When burning a matchstick near Hydrogen gas, it burns with a 'pop' sound.
📌 Always remember the chemical formula for Plaster of Paris (CaSO₄·½H₂O) and Gypsum (CaSO₄·2H₂O).
📌 Tooth decay starts when the pH of the mouth falls below 5.5 (which is why toothpaste is basic to neutralize it).
quick_recap: ⭐ Strong acids completely dissociate into ions in water, while weak acids only partially dissociate.
⭐ The Chlor-alkali process is used to produce Chlorine gas, Hydrogen gas, and Sodium Hydroxide from saltwater (brine).
⭐ Antacids (like Milk of Magnesia) are mild bases used to cure acidity in the stomach.
